scope: Original whole living cynodont, skeletal anchors with explicitly artistic soft tissues and neutral stance. Not a fossil replica or modern mammal variant.

scale.basis: All artist nominal proportions for small cynodont readability, NOT measurements of any single specimen. Tail incomplete in Brink specimen; exact length unknown.

pose: Quiet quadrupedal stance, forelimbs moderately splayed, low but ground-clear torso, hindfeet beneath/just lateral to hips; head -Y, relaxed tapering tail. Limb angles are conservative art, not claimed uniquely established gait.

surface_profile.name: palette-only
surface_profile.materials: 4–6 subdued gray/olive/slate/tan palette values, not fossil pigment claim. No emissive eyes.
surface_profile.detail: Closed solid geometry, single-sided opaque materials, subtle planar sculpting; no DoubleSide sheets, detached bead limbs or noisy repeated detail. Integument and colors artistic, not preserved facts.

coordinates.origin: Exact bbox center of actual Z0 contact points from the four feet. Algorithm and tolerance in origin-scope-addendum.json; not whole-body bbox or point mean.

view_plan.source: Exact final GLB clean-import, fixed numeric camera/light/color template and hash-bound manifest.
view_plan.greybox: Inspect head/trunk/limb/tail silhouette and four grounded feet before detail.
view_plan.extra_views: Only targeted diagnostic for concrete ambiguity; no mandatory8 views in current scoped making.

scientific_limits: Brink Fig5A/B drawings include freely restored and rearranged obscured regions; Fig6 is the actual fossil. Never trace drawing as entirely preserved anatomy.
Distal tail vertebrae in Brink drawings were weathered away; tail length/curve artist nominal. No sleeping/hibernating behavior claim from curled fossil.
Skull CT rendering is bone, not living head surface: cover temporal openings and cheek arches with plausible soft tissues, do not make hollow living head.

No preserved coat/color/whiskers/external pinna evidence in these sources. Choose understated textureless integument; neither claim hairlessness nor add fluffy fur, prominent mammalian ears or whisker arrays.

Five manual digits directly anchored by Fig15; hindfeet conservatively reconstructed with compact five-digit cynodont pattern, not directly resolved by the selected specimen photos. Exact phalangeal counts and hindclaw morphology unclaimed.
Do not copy scan, mesh, source image texture or existing animal model. All original lowpoly geometry.

morphology.obligation: Moderately elongated low snout, broad posterior skull/cheek region and short neck; small lateral eyes. Closed mouth, no exposed skeletal fenestrae or giant saber tusks. Canine presence may stay under closed lip.
morphology.source: DigiMorph UCMP40466 actual CT skull pixels.

morphology.obligation: Elongated low trunk with coherent shoulder-to-hip transition and finite rounded width; four short bent limbs, forelimbs lateral rather than columnar mammal legs; neutral stance is interpretive.
morphology.source: Brink actual Fig6 fossil and explicitly restored Fig5A/B; living volume artistic.

morphology.obligation: Four compact feet; five small separated manual digits with restrained curved claws, no mitten paddle or giant digging shovel. Hindfeet five understated digits as declared reconstruction; avoid claims of exact joints.
morphology.source: Kümmell & Frey2014 Fig15 actual manus BP/1/5558; pes conservative inference.

morphology.obligation: One slender smoothly tapering tail, modest length and relaxed curve, no fan/tassel or stiff reptile spikes.
morphology.source: Proximal skeleton and declared missing distal portion; exact length artistic.

acceptance_obligations: Four exact-final-GLB views front/side/top/perspective only: front shows broad cheek/low head and two forefeet; side elongated trunk, short bent limbs and clear belly; top finite width and four limb roots; perspective confirms all four grounded feet, tail attachment and no bead joints.
Manual digit/claw structure should read in source and at useful render size; use only a targeted foot diagnostic if four standard views leave concrete doubt. Do not silently certify unresolved toes.
No horns/tusks, external ear flaps, armor, fluffy dog coat or exposed skull holes. Distinguish from Diictodon via non-beaked snout and absence of enlarged paired tusks.

Two full deterministic factory-startup builds in isolated outputs with semantic digests/metrics, not two exports; default asset_common/render_candidate_views helpers, dedicated EXPORT with one identity asset root, closed opaque single-sided solids.
Independent morphology QA; full production eight-view/GPU/runtime/scene/user acceptance not implied.
production_boundary: Full static-stylized-v1 production8/GPU/scene contract is retained as reference but NOT claimed passed or imposed as current maker scope; user-requested4view model acceptance is separate.
